input.specimen: Synthetic witness ID, positive integer revision, circular 45–180 mm diameter and lateral offset ±35 mm; fit must leave 2 mm radial clearance
input.axes: Strictly increasing +X and +Z axes in mm, 2–31 samples per axis; rectangle fits inside the circular witness. Z increases toward the viewer at the front.
input.layers: Exactly two distinct synthetic layer IDs in substrate-to-top order, row-major nanometre maps with cells in 0–2,000 nm
input.restriction: These are already prepared read-only synthetic maps. There are no physical process inputs.

output.fields: Sample ID, source revision, preserved axes and layers, passive fit, selected (ix, iz) location and cumulative bottom/top values in nm

failure: Wrong schema, grid range, shapes, invalid map corners, blocked clearance or missing witness rejects the requested action. No fabricated output.
limitations: Only a static documentary cabinet and an invented inert diagrammatic load tray. No powered operation, process settings, material recipe, gas/vacuum system, real stage/door travel, thickness metrology calibration or hardware-fit claim.
downstream: No verified station consumes this exact schema yet.
